settings.heading: The Brownstone Tote
settings.body:
There is a particular kind of day that requires you to step out of the house prepared for anything, yet unburdened by the weight of it. A day that might begin at the market, stretch into an uninterrupted hour at your favourite corner table, and end with an unexpected stack of paperbacks that simply must come home with you.

This is the bag for those days. Cut full, soft enough to take the shape of whatever it is asked to carry, and light enough to forget you are carrying it.
settings.pull_quote: Leave the house without a plan.

settings.heading: The Pairing
settings.note:
The bag and the scarf come from different makers. Choosing each of them, and knotting one to the other, is the house's work — and the whole idea behind In Her Purse.

Some things the house makes: the perfume is blended here, by hand, in small batches. Some things it chooses. This one it chose, and then it made the pair.
